|===
|Target |Linked |Default |Why |Tested by

|emscripten
|BearSSL
|BearSSL
|the only AEAD backend there: webcpp does not build OpenSSL for Emscripten, and BearSSL's code is small
|`+default_bearssl+`

|wasip2, wasip3
|BearSSL, with or without OpenSSL
|BearSSL
|small, and constant time by design, where OpenSSL is built no-asm
|`+default_bearssl+`, `+default_both_wasm+`

|wasip2, wasip3
|BearSSL and OpenSSL, with WEBCPP_CRYPTO_DEFAULT_BACKEND_OPENSSL
|OpenSSL
|the program's choice
|`+default_openssl_wasm+`

|native
|OpenSSL, with or without BearSSL
|OpenSSL
|the fastest natively: assembly with the CPU's AES and carry-less multiplication instructions, on x86-64 and on ARMv8, where BearSSL has no ARM hardware path
|`+default_both+`

|native
|BearSSL and OpenSSL, with WEBCPP_CRYPTO_DEFAULT_BACKEND_BEARSSL
|BearSSL
|the program's choice: on MSVC, OpenSSL is built no-asm
|`+default_selected+`

|native
|BearSSL alone
|BearSSL
|the backend that is linked
|`+default_bearssl+`
